## The shift

ChatGPT is a paid channel now. Almost nobody is running it.

The early-mover window is open, and it's measured in months. OpenAI opened ChatGPT Ads to self-serve advertisers. It's live in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. The advertisers who build campaign history and creative learnings now will have a structural cost advantage before the rest catch up.

## Context hints, not keywords

On Google you bid on words. On Meta you guess at interests. In ChatGPT you target context hints: plain-language descriptions of the situation your buyer is actually in. Someone mid-decision, describing their exact problem, is a different quality of intent than anything search or social can offer.

- Mid-decision intent: your ad appears while someone is weighing options and ready to act, not idly scrolling.
- Written for the moment: chat_card creative built to read as a useful continuation of the answer, never a repurposed banner.
- Measured properly: a pixel and a server-side Conversions API, so ad blockers and cookie limits don't hide your results.
- Inside the answer: your logo and a link to your site, in a clearly labelled card right below ChatGPT's reply.

## The setup sprint

We stand up the whole channel in about five days. One-time, about five working days. Everything done right the first time. $1,750 covers one intent angle and one chat_card concept; $2,500 adds multiple angles, more creative and a structured test matrix.

1. Account and verification: Ads Manager setup, business verification, billing and brand identity, done right the first time.
2. Tracking before launch: OpenAI pixel, server-side Conversions API and UTMs, installed and verified before a dollar is spent.
3. Context-hint strategy: mapped to the real ChatGPT conversations your buyers are having. Intent, not keyword guesses.
4. chat_card creative: title, body and image built for a mid-conversation reader, in your voice.
5. Campaign build: click-objective campaigns and ad groups by intent, in the markets that are open to you.
6. First optimisation and handover: seven to fourteen days of tuning, then a clear handover. Or we keep running it.

- About 1.5 times higher conversion rate from ChatGPT referrals versus other digital channels.
- 60 to 80% more time on site than social traffic. High-intent behaviour.

Early-channel and industry figures. Shared to set expectations, not a performance guarantee.

## Straight talk

It's early. We run it like a pilot, and we tell you the truth.

- What we promise: correct setup, real measurement, sharp creative, and a fast read on whether this channel works for you.
- What we won't promise: a guaranteed return on a platform that's weeks old, EU reach (not open yet), or that software does the whole job. The hands-on work is the point.

- Setup Sprint: USD $1,750 or $2,500, one-time, about five working days. $1,750 covers one intent angle and one chat_card concept, fully set up and launched. $2,500 expands to multiple angles, more creative variations and a structured test matrix. Fixed price agreed up front, plus a handover doc and walkthrough.

## Who it's for

A quick honesty check before we take your money.

- Best fit: B2B and SaaS, considered purchases, longer-cycle services, education and training. Anyone whose buyers research before they commit. Live for advertisers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.
- Not yet: restricted categories (finance, health, legal, gambling, alcohol, adult, political), and hyper-local targeting (country-level only for now). We'll tell you straight if it's not your channel.

## How it works

From call to live in days.

1. Strategy call: your goals, your offer, the markets open to you. We confirm fit and eligibility.
2. Audit: your funnel, landing pages and the conversations where you can credibly show up.
3. Plan: context hints, creative angles and a test matrix built for fast learning.
4. Build and launch: account, tracking, creative, campaigns. Configured and live.
5. Optimise: we read the signal, cut what doesn't work, and scale what does.

## FAQ

How is this different from Google or Meta ads?
No keywords, no interest profiles. You target context hints, plain-language descriptions of the situation your buyer is in. The ad appears mid-conversation, as a clearly labelled sponsored card below ChatGPT's answer. It doesn't change what ChatGPT says.

Who actually sees ChatGPT ads?
Users on ChatGPT's Free and Go tiers. The Go tier ($8 per month) skews towards founders, freelancers and small-business decision-makers, people with real buying authority, which is part of why early performance data is strong for considered purchases. Plus, Pro, Business and Enterprise tiers are ad-free.

Can you run this from Australia for our UK or US business?
Yes. We run a verified account that can target every open market: the US, UK, Canada, Australia and New Zealand. Targeting is country-level for now. The EU isn't open yet.

How do you measure results?
A browser pixel plus the server-side Conversions API (which survives ad blockers and cookie limits), UTMs, and a dedicated analytics view. Because a lot of ChatGPT-driven conversions arrive later via branded search or direct, we watch those during campaigns too.

What does a ChatGPT ad look like?
A "chat_card" below the response: a short title, a line of body copy, an image and a link, clearly marked Sponsored. We write and design it for the conversation it appears in.

Should we move our Google or Meta budget to it?
No. It's a new layer that reaches people earlier in their research, while your existing channels catch them at the moment of action. We run it alongside, measured together.
